summary: CONF1 first-bar confirmation exit in live v2 and the paper harness. Pin was withheld twice: first for the absence of any enable flag on a new real-money exit rule (against the repo's own pattern of ten sibling exit flags defaulting False, and #647's merge-dark precedent), then again when the second head addressed only paper scope. This head resolves it with strategy_schwab_1m_v2_confirmation_exit_enabled default False, gated inside _publish_confirmation_evaluation, and it goes further than asked: the dark path terminalizes the durable outbox row via published_at, so enabling CONF1 later cannot release a stale dark-period exit. Verified the gate is load-bearing by mutation - forcing it True turns test_dark_confirmation_records_but_cannot_reach_the_emitter red with 'dark CONF1 reached the live emitter'; source restored clean. Tests carry a real controlled pair, dark cannot reach the emitter and enabled does, plus an assertion that the default is False. 167 touched tests pass; validate green on both runs. Verified byte-identity of every live-money surface across the three heads so earlier approval carries: confirmation_exit.py, oms/service.py, strategy_core/schwab_1m_v2.py, broker_adapters/schwab.py and routing.py, db/models.py, migration 0018, and both paper files are unchanged from the heads already reviewed; only the bot gate, the setting and its tests changed. The live design was checked directly and I could not construct a double-exit or naked position: release_native_oco_for_close refuses to treat a DELETE as release without a fresh broker read proving no sell child is working, marks partial fills unsafe, and the OMS fails closed on 'if protection != released: return'; an unretained target bar discards rather than exits. The 'unknown' conflation raised last round is now distinguished as FIRED-UNKNOWN. Migration 20260902_0018 is additive, chain 0017 to 0018. NOT verified and left to the operator: codex reported SEG1 boarded as superseded, but SEG1 appears nowhere in docs at this head except my own now-stale watch item in session-handoff.md; I am correcting that separately rather than blocking this pin.
